title: Caught!
description:
Leave It to the Professionals
Amateurs attempt outrageous activities; hilarious stunts, spills, and thrills gone wrong showcase backyard engineering, clueless humans and uncooperative machinery.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E10 — Confiscated Copper Conundrum
When police raid his underground still site, Josh joins Tickle and Henry in a shine run for a stock car legend; Mark and Digger contend with a rotten-egg taste in their blueberry brandy.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E11 — Penny Wise, Impound Foolish
Josh constructs a decoy in a daring plot to retrieve his confiscated copper still from the police impound lot. Mike and Jerry promise to deliver something they've never attempted before. Mark and Huck face off with their own backwoods bear problem.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E12 — Braking Badly
When the brakes fail on Mark and Huck's bootleg vehicle, their luck and their shine quickly hit rock bottom; Mike and Jerry cross police lines to get their shine back; Mark and Digger score a prized strain of wheat.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E13 — Spirit Animal
Tim, Tickle and Henry confront the rogue shiners who torched their stash house; Mike and Jerry make liquor from candy roaster squash.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E14 — Cocke County Crackdown
Mark and Digger team up with Josh to hunt down a police informant; Tim and Tickle plot revenge on shiners who destroyed $20,000 worth of their liquor.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E15 — Wanted Drunk or Alive
Tickle makes tariff-free apple brandy to help resolve the shortage of American liquor on Canadian shelves; Mike and Jerry learn they're wanted men; Josh discovers the source of industrial ethanol.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S15 E16 — Outlaw & Order
Tim enlists Tickle to smuggle tariff-free shine by airplane and rallies a band of fellow outlaws to take back his family's turf; Mark and Digger turn the law against a counterfeiter; Mike and Jerry push Mark Rogers past his limit.

S02 E10 — Battle of the Judges
Tim Smith challenges Mark and Digger to a moonshine-making rematch; the three legends face off to see who can bring the best jar of moonshine to the table and win the ultimate bragging rights.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E01 — Meth Gators
In a methamphetamine hotspot, drugs seep into local waterways, creating aggressive alligators; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante investigates the effects of meth on these reptiles and attempts to capture and rehabilitate a meth gator.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E05 — FBI Inside Job
A master hacker steals $400 million and eludes capture by the FBI, until the Feds realize he's one of them; millions in drugs are stolen from a super-secure warehouse; criminals run an elaborate scheme to steal a fortune worth of gas in plain sight.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E02 — Cocaine Sub Wars
South American drug lords build a fleet of narco subs to carry cocaine to the US; a gambling addict masterminds a bold casino heist.

title: Outlaw Tech
description:
S01 E04 — Escape of El Chapo
Inside the science and engineering that helped El Chapo escape from the most guarded prison in Mexico; in just 10 hours, $40 million disappears from ATMs across the planet; a high-tech scheme turns the tables on a casino for a huge payout.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S02 E09 — The $8,000 Man
Officers stop a man suspected of money laundering; cocaine is found hidden in an unexpected area of a shipping truck; a traveler is caught trying to bring weaponry into Mexico; a father is stopped when trying to smuggle medication for his son.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E11 — Ruffled Feathers
Officers receive a tip-off on a vehicle loaded with cartel cash; a man released from jail finds himself in trouble for smuggling hundreds of prescription pills; a magician comes under scrutiny for traveling with a dove he uses as a prop.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E06 — Marshal Matters
Officers discover an illicit load in a shipment of garbage bags; a U.S. Marshal exhibits some disorderly conduct; a woman previously imprisoned for trafficking meth is found with an excessive amount of pills; knockoff luxury goods are uncovered.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E07 — Going Out With a Bang
A retiring officer makes a significant bust before hanging up his hat; a bus arrives with more than just passengers in tow; a mother wanted on a nine-year-old warrant for theft is apprehended; a car unexpectedly explodes in the middle of a bridge.

description:

Following the manufacturing processes behind flight simulators, traditional bookbinding, greenhouse tomatoes and hurricane-proof shutters.

Exploring how everyday items like pasta dies, blueberries, composting toilets and surge arresters are made.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E03 — The Tip Jar Bandit
Tizzy investigates complaints of a serial tip jar thief; a woman goes on a tirade in a parking lot; the police sort out a cyclist's accusations against a motorist.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E06 — The Bumper Sticker Brawl
Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker; a judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast food worker, and a couple of road rage incidents have Tizzy fired up.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E07 — Road Rage on the Underage
Tizzy investigates a driver who violently assaults a teenage boy riding a bike; a customer catches a brazen shoplifter, and a woman nearly runs over her boyfriend at a gas station.

Tizzy investigates a frightening confrontation between a man and a pair of Beverly Hills reality show stars; a woman allegedly pepper sprays another driver for going too slowly, and a delivery person busts up a Taco Bell.

S01 E05 — Boom Phase
As the bluefin fishery reaches its mid-season peak, three centuries-old fishing strategies compete for dominance.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E02 — Drunk Bears
A late-night encounter with a beer-hunting bear sparks a cross-country investigation; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante tracks break-ins and uncovers a strange new trend, bears invading homes to chug booze and devour marijuana edibles.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E05 — Kodiak Sea Monster
A mysterious apex predator is stalking orcas and boats off the coast of Kodiak, AK; sea monster sightings, first studied by Sanderson before his death, have spiked in that area recently.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E06 — Cave Dragon of Arkansas
When Ozarks locals report frightening encounters with a mysterious, dragon-like beast, the team conducts their most ambitious hunt yet.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E02 — Snow Beast of Ruby Creek
The team investigates recent encounters with a monstrous apex predator in the wilderness of British Columbia; using never-before-seen clues from Ivan Sanderson's lost archive, they uncover new evidence that may finally distinguish fact from fiction.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E03 — Thunderbird of Pennsylvania
The team makes a discovery while investigating sightings of a large bird of prey terrorizing Chestnut Ridge, Pennsylvania; Sanderson believes it to be the mysterious thunderbird, a razor-clawed predator documented in Native folklore.

title: Lost Monster Files
description:
S01 E04 — Mystery of the Minnesota Wildman
The team investigates a stranger-than-fiction murder mystery involving the Wildman of Minnesota; known as the Ice Man, its body became a sideshow attraction that Sanderson examined himself before it mysteriously disappeared.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E01 — Mountain of Madness Part 1
Zak and the crew travel to Casper, Wyoming, to investigate local reports of UFO sightings, alien abductions and hauntings near an ominous mountain and abandoned military base; will a massive storm prevent the team from unraveling the mystery?

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E02 — Mountain of Madness Part 2
Zak and his crew push higher atop Casper Mountain into the world of storied witches; their investigation leads to a haunted forest where annual summer solstice rituals may have opened a gateway to another dimension.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E03 — Hollydale Asylum of Hell
Zak and the crew uncover evidence of disturbing satanic rituals when they explore an abandoned medical complex in Downey, California, that once housed dangerously deranged patients.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E04 — Hospital of the Damned
Zak and the crew gain access to a shuttered Pasadena, California, hospital that has become a hotbed for devil worship; Zak suspects the evil originated with a heinous murder nearly 25 years ago.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S30 E05 — Darkness of Belmont Park
Zak and his crew investigate phantom footsteps, laughter and spectral figures at a San Diego amusement park; they discover a dark cloud hangs over the beloved establishment, which has entertained millions.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E01 — Hunt for Petra's Lost Tombs
With unprecedented access, Josh digs in front of Petra's treasury; searching for clues to the mysterious civilization that created one of the new Seven Wonders of the World, Josh rappels a seven-story cliff face to perform a high-tech scan.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E02 — Petra's Secrets Revealed
Rewriting history, Josh helps discover a tomb at Petra's iconic Treasury; the twelve skeletons inside may belong to a royal family of Petra; state-of-the-art tech could finally decipher the charred fragments of ancient scrolls.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E07 — Looted Treasures of Cambodia
Pushing into remote jungles, Josh investigates one of the 20th century's biggest heists - looting of Cambodian statues worth hundreds of millions; Josh rappels into a crumbling pyramid and digs up a treasure trove of missing monuments.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E08 — Cambodia's Stolen Monuments
A clandestine meeting with a Cambodian looter puts Josh on the trail of multi-million-dollar stolen monuments; Josh dives into a murky moat, where he unearths a priceless lost statue and a missing piece of a national treasure.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E07 — America's MIA Heroines
In World War II's closing days, 18 American servicewomen were lost off the Ivory Coast. Armed with new technology and fresh insights from the crash archives, Josh joins Project Recover to guide the search for the heroines' lost C47 plane.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E06 — Chasing Africa's Atlantis
Josh dives the waters off Tanzania to find a lost city and its fortunes, search ancient shipwrecks and uncover what could be the walls of a lost city that traded riches.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E01 — Hunt for Alexander the Great
Josh is on the hunt for the lost tomb of Alexander the Great; he dives Egypt's coast, revealing ruins of Alexander's Royal Quarter; he tunnels under modern Alexandria, but a water pump malfunction puts everything at risk.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S13 E02 — Alexander's Lost Tomb
Spanning Europe and Africa, Josh's chase for Alexander's remains and fortune ramps up; clues mount in a flooded ruin beneath Alexandria, Egypt; Josh gathers evidence Alexander's body may actually lie in Venice's St. Mark's Cathedral.

title: This Is Mark Rober
description:
S01 E06 — Turbo Sports
Mark gets sporty in a field-goal kicking contest with his mechanical creation, shows off a rocket-powered golf club and perfects the art of rock skipping.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E03 — Cocaine Hippos
Aggressive hippos raised by the cocaine kingpin Pablo Escobar have escaped his abandoned compound in Colombia, becoming a dangerous and deadly invasive species; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante embarks upon a plan to stop them.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E07 — Surprise Fortunes
While searching for better ground on Lightning Creek, Rick is rocked by surprising news; Parker gets greedy and expands his Sulphur claim; Mike pivots on Paradise Hill to impress Tony.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E08 — Parker Comes Calling
Kevin is sent reeling when Parker shows up demanding the money he's owed; Parker discovers he's losing gold from a wash plant on Dominion Creek; Tony's son Mike puts new recruits through boot camp on Paradise Hill.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E09 — Playing With Fire
Forest fires threaten to shut down Parker's Sulphur Creek claim before he can get all the gold out; Rick decides whether to move back to Duncan Creek; Tony loses nearly $750,000 in gold battling a wash plant issue.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E10 — New Levels of Chaos
Parker unleashes chaos as the team tries to get four wash plants running. Tony splurges on a new wash plant to get more gold. Kevin tries to broker a deal with his dad. Rick fires up at Vegas Valley.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E10 — He's In the Water!
When Wizard deckhand Lynn Guitard falls overboard in 15 foot seas, Keith and Monte scramble to rescue him before hypothermia sets in; on the Northwestern, Sig lets Sophia prove herself at the Russian line.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E11 — O Captain, My Captain
On the Aleutian Lady, greenhorn Todd's abscessed tooth forces Rick to consider a costly return to Dutch Harbor.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E12 — Crushing Ice
As Arctic ice wreaks havoc on the fishing grounds, Rick risks losing a fortune in crab pots. Johnathan tests the Time Bandit's reinforced bow in a desperate attempt to save the gear.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E13 — Those in Peril on the Sea
Captains Sig and Sophia shift their fishing strategy as back-to-back injuries plague the Northwestern deck crew.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E14 — Curse of the Hybrids
Captains Sig and Sophia locate hybrid crab, hitting the jackpot, but filling their tanks creates an imbalance, putting the Northwestern on the brink of capsize.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E15 — Aleutian Solution
Sig's crew races to jettison pots and repair a flooding compartment below deck. Rick radios Johnathan to help hide his honey hole, but when Jake spots the Time Bandit's unusual movements, he calls Rick's bluff.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E16 — Contagion
As Jake sets gear in heavy seas, a painful skin infection spreads among the Cornelia Marie crew.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E17 — Raw Nerves
On the Time Bandit, Johnathan delegates dentistry duties when his brother Neal's dental implants fail far out to sea. Battling 25-foot waves, Keith leans heavily on his co-captain Monte.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E18 — Runaway Train
As 25-foot breakers pound the fleet, critical systems fail at the worst possible time; Sig's engine runs wild, Jake loses power, John's crane cracks and Rick must replace a lackluster deckhand, opening the door for the return of a favorite greenhorn.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E19 — Father, Brother, Sailor, Son
As the season nears its end, tragedy strikes on the Aleutian Lady when greenhorn Todd Meadows falls overboard. As Captain Rick and the crew fight to save their crewmate, the true stakes of fishing on the Bering Sea hit home across the fleet.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E06 — Tornado of the Year
Every year tornado junkies descend on America's tornado alley; these storm chasers put everything on the line to prove they're the best in the game.

S01 E05 — Spin City
While chasing a monster in Alabama, Sarah parts ways with Reed moments before he takes the Dominator for a spin inside a tornado.

Zak's team braces for a chaotic spiritual storm when they are called to Ohio; they help a couple reclaim their historic dream home from a horde of aggressive ghosts; could the capture of a childlike form reveal the culprit?
